subject.title: refactor(discord): authorize widgets by channel audience

question: Should Discord Activity widgets intentionally stop honoring the agent command/DM allowlists and instead grant access to every user Discord reports in the matching channel Activity instance?
rationale: This changes an existing documented access-control boundary on a public Activity route; tests establish the proposed implementation, but cannot choose the permanent operator and security contract.

options.title: Confirm channel-audience authorization
options.body: Approve the Discord-instance-and-channel boundary as the intended pre-stable contract, then require live proof of the permitted and rejected cases.

options.title: Retain explicit widget restriction
options.body: Keep an Activity-specific audience restriction or another documented operator control if channel membership is too broad for existing deployments.

recommendation.title: Confirm channel-audience authorization
recommendation.body: Approve the Discord-instance-and-channel boundary as the intended pre-stable contract, then require live proof of the permitted and rejected cases.
